name: Threshold tau_F of R-MLP's own closing tendency
report: v0.6, Section 3.21 (N64: arm RN and council BHN; N66: arm RK and council BHK)
signal_F: At each value statement in the thinking before token 8,192: the model's own probability that the next token is </think>, read at each position from the last token of the value to 12 tokens later (13 positions, not beyond the measured thinking). F is the maximum of these probabilities.
rule: 2 % rule: tau_F is the smallest threshold such that at most 2 % of the wrong value statements of the development runs lie strictly above it.
fixed_before: Derived only on earlier runs, before any result on the fresh sets F2, F3 and F4.

development.note: 'correct' with a bell counts runs that close before the deadline and are correct, plus runs cut at a value that is correct (no answer generated in this development step).
